We met with Dr Lam, and she was amazing and compassionate with our case. She did everything she could for our senior dog, and was responsive to our own requests and concerns (like wanting to minimize her stress during everything medical, including giving us what we needed to care for our dog at home for a few hours overnight). Pricing was reasonable and transparent.

We'll absolutely be coming back if we have future health concerns for our pets. Remarkable team xx

And let me say worth the drive..from the tone with the receptionist over the phone and with the walk in process and examination. Everyone was top tier and kind! And Reasonable. Love when people love what they do!

I’d put 10 stars if I could, after calling around and even visiting a place or two it was seeming hopeless to get my baby who had been attacked help. Everywhere was extremely gougy, this place was able to help me at an affordable cost, so much so it was an easy let’s do it. They checked up, as the surgery went on. They were informative, professional, and actually here for the purpose of the pets. It’s good to know there are still places out here who are actually trying to help. Thank you so much. God bless
Thanks so much for the positive review!

On entering Dallas Animal Urgent Care I was greeted with grate customer service. My French Bull dog was sick and they took him right back . Kept me informed on what was happening . I recommend this hospital. Al together 5 stare so far !! Let’s just hope my dog makes it 😭

I am incredibly grateful for the help my dog ​​Chanel received and the excellent treatment from Dr. Woodruff and Dr. Alberto. Thanks to them, my Pomeranian Chanel returned home safe and sound. All the staff were so attentive!

They treated with kindness and was very helpful. They provided assistance with getting my German Shepherd in and out of my vehicle. They brought her a blanket and cold water to drink to calm her down. They staff was absolutely wonderful and very professional and caring.  This is the best experienceI ever had at a vet clinic.
Thanks so much for the positive review!
Thanks for the positive review!
Excellent service pyometra surgery was successful reasonable price staff very professional and knowledgeable

My favorite place extremely reasonable especially when in an emergency situation any other 'urgent' care is higher priced and the best vets and vet techs, just to be honest most vets these days, are in this just for the money-profit these lady's and gentlemen here are honest to goodness animal people here, I don't know how you pick them, but you'll have the most caring and loving group of human beings right here in one place to help love and care for your animals.. very special place to have..
Thank you guys for everything.. ♥️🐕🦮🐕‍🦺🐩🐈‍⬛🐈

I hate to leave a review like this, but my hope is that my feedback could potentially save a pup’s life.

The vets were kind and courteous, but I felt overwhelmed with medical jargon without being clearly told how severe my dog’s condition actually was. I understand that people want to manage costs, and I am one of those people. However, had I understood that the recommended medical treatments were potentially life or death for my dog, I would have spared no expense. That is ultimately what I did by taking him to an animal hospital, but sadly, I still ended up losing my only companion.

My other major concern is that when my dog was released from this clinic, I was not given paperwork detailing what medications he was given or the dosages. When his condition worsened and I took him to the VEG animal hospital, they did not know what medications he had received, which limited their ability to treat him and, in my belief, contributed to his death.

If there is one thing I hope this clinic takes from my experience, it is to please be completely transparent about the severity of a dog’s condition and provide owners with proper medical records, including medications and dosages, upon discharge. That information could be critical if the dog’s condition worsens and they need to seek emergency care elsewhere.

I truly believe that if I had been given a clearer understanding of how serious his condition was and had been provided with his complete medical information, my dog might still be here today. He was a healthy 8-year-old Pekingese with no prior health issues and passed away within 24 hours of becoming sick.

The staff is caring and very attentive. We arrived at 9:30 and they still took us in even though by the time we were seen they were closed. I appreciated that they were very upfront about pricing and recommendations and the prices were much more manageable than a traditional animal ER. Dr. Green was very kind and knowledgeable and I appreciated her thoroughness in assessing our cat’s illness. I will definitely be returning for any future veterinary urgent care needs.

My baby Dallas was mauled by a dog and we came in severely traumatized in pieces. The team took amazing care of of her and were so kind to me. I highly recommend this vet they are an amazing team ❤️🙏 …

Unfortunately I lost two fur babies in 90 days. It’s never easy making the decision to euthanize your family. They made the experience a little bit easier. They are soooo thoughtful and really care about your pet. Thank you Angels for all you do for us.
Fast service for our lil dog Samson

We had the tough decision to put our Piper down after 14 years. We went in the night before, they got us in quick and started the exams. As much as we wanted the best treatments for her she had no platelets left and was bleeding from all over. We made the decision the next morning to put her down. They did not overcharge us and were so patient with us. I highly recommend them for emergency needs. We miss her. pit/Aussie mix. Best dog ever.
I got on the wait list before leaving home and was seen upon entry. Great, caring staff. You're in good hands here

This is the best place I’ve ever found!!! They are completely organized, so friendly & warm, professional & the place is so clean. They are timely with the appointments & have an online waiting system set up. Can’t say enough about them!!!! Thank you so much!

Absolutely awful, I brought my cat in for help and even before we were given a quote Dr Gordon was insistent on trying to euthanize her! Horrible bedside table manners! She also assumed we couldn’t pay the bill and kept repeating if we couldn’t pay they could just go ahead and euthanize her! Not only that but it was also mentioned if they do operate on her, if they decide it’s better to euthanize her they’ll make that decision! Never in my life have I been spoken to that way by any veterinarian, and I’d never speak poorly on someone else but in this case that was just terrible.
Thanks so much for taking the time to leave us a positive review!

Dr.Danawala was the absolute sweetest! She explained what was going on with my cat thoroughly & what she thought would be the best course of action. The nurse that took care of us was the absolute sweetest! I could just tell my cat shadow was comfortable in their care. Kelsey was just the kindest at checkout explaining all of shadows meds. Their care was exceptional! Glad to say my cat is doing much better 🤍

Last night, we took my sweet kitty into Dallas Animal Urgent Care, and she was diagnosed with congestive heart failure. Our entire stay, the team treated me and my family with so much respect, dignity, and love. They treated my baby with so much love. They gave us as much time as we needed, even staying after close to give us time with her. They blessed us with compassionate care and went above and beyond to make sure that my kitty and my family both were taken care of. They gave us one of the biggest blessings I’ve ever received, and I will always be thankful.

Vet was sweet, patience, and kind with us. She explained what was going on in a professional yet kind way. Thank you so much for your kindness.
The front desk team were great as well. All the team…doctor, techs, and everybody went above and beyond. Really compassionate team. Thank you so much.

After going to a different vet, and having that vet botch a neutering I brought my dog here and they were able to nurse him back to health. Gave him meds and provided comfort to myself in promising he would be alright. I Recommend Sarah Roberts to anyone looking for a vet in the local area. Thank you guys so much for helping me and my dog

READ THIS IF YOUR PETS MEAN THE WORLD TO YOU! THEY ONLY CARE ABOUT MONEY!

I am extremely disappointed with our experiences at this veterinary clinic, and after everything our family has experienced, I feel that other pet owners deserve to know what happened. Most recently, I brought my 9-week-old kitten to this clinic after she suffered two broken toes. We were given three treatment options, but the veterinarian repeatedly pushed amputation. I understand that amputation can sometimes be medically necessary, but this was a 9-week-old kitten whose bones are still developing, and I did not feel comfortable making such a permanent decision without getting another opinion. I asked for a second opinion, and this clinic referred us to another veterinarian in McKinney. The second veterinarian told us that, in my kitten’s situation and at her young age, amputation was too extreme and that there were other things to consider before taking such a permanent step. I am incredibly grateful that we decided to get another opinion before agreeing to surgery. What was even more upsetting was that we received a call from the original clinic on Sunday evening asking, “How did the amputation go?” We explained that we did NOT proceed with the amputation. Despite that, the conversation continued with questions about how much we were willing to pay for the amputation. At that point, it felt like the procedure was being pushed more than my kitten’s individual situation and well-being. I was also concerned about the medication prescribed to my kitten. She was given a strong narcotic medication that caused significant sedation. She became extremely sleepy and lost her appetite. When we saw the second veterinarian, they discontinued that medication because of how strongly it was affecting her. For a 9-week-old kitten, this was extremely concerning to us. Unfortunately, this is not our only negative experience with this clinic. We previously brought one of our dogs here, and her condition continued to worsen. We ultimately had to take her to another urgent care, where they treated her when she was in very serious condition. We were told at the urgent care that she was close to losing her life. That experience was terrifying and left our family questioning the care she had received here. We have also experienced the heartbreaking loss of another animal in the past after she was taken to a Dallas animal urgent care. We were told that the medication she received was too strong, and she ultimately lost her life. I understand that every medical situation is different and that not every outcome can be prevented, but experiences like these have made us extremely cautious about medications, treatment plans, and whether the least invasive options are being considered first. After these experiences, I cannot shake the feeling that the focus at this clinic is too heavily centered around expensive treatments and procedures rather than first doing everything reasonably possible to preserve an animal’s health and quality of life. I am not saying that every recommendation made by a veterinarian will be wrong, and I understand that some animals genuinely require surgery or strong medications. My issue is the way these situations were handled and the lack of confidence we were left with afterward. Our animals are family. When we take them to a veterinarian, we expect their well-being to come first. We should not feel pressured into an irreversible procedure, especially with a very young animal, without feeling that all reasonable alternatives have been thoroughly considered. I strongly recommend that pet owners ask questions, understand every treatment option, and get a second opinion before agreeing to an irreversible procedure or treatment plan. In our kitten’s case, getting that second opinion made a huge difference and prevented us from making a decision that could not be undone.

From phone call/front desk to Vet Tech and Dr. Green, fantastic experience at Dallas Animal Urgent Care.  Competent, hospitable and caring.  Prices aren’t bad either. She took the time to explain and answer questions.  Everyone was very caring (cannot emphasize this enough).  We thank you and so does Cosmo🐾. #🐜bitessuck
Very expensive and no compassion for animals suffering

I added this clinic to my map as my favorite 🥰 I truly recommend it; they are very caring and approachable people who always find a solution to your problem. I've been twice and I was very delighted with them. They offer good prices and provide loving and caring attention to your pet 😍🥰😍🥰👌🙏 …
Thanks so much for the 5-star review!

Very fast and friendly. The vets were able to address my concerns and more. I feel very comfortable taking my pups here if there is an emergency.

This is an excellent facility. Clean, efficient, understanding and cost friendly. They made me feel at ease when I brought my furbaby in. Having the online check in is a life saver. Would recommend them for all my emergent needs!

I can't stress enough how well the staff treated me and my dog Lucky. He is usually very nervous and a bit skittish when it comes to vets but not here.
For this urgent care to be as busy as they are they were very fast with getting to me and letting me know what was going and providing me with options for further treatment.

You guys were awesome and I recommend anyone who it looking for their dog to get seen to come here. If you want them to be treated as the best friend that they are, this is where you need to bring them.

I give you guys an A+ from reception, to tech and Doctor!!! Customer service was top of the line.

Thank you to the staff here for being angels during this tough time. They even sent me this condolences card a few weeks later 😭❤️
Highly recomend Dallas animal urgent care affordable and they care. Helped my puppy and even did follow up calls to check on her
These people are amazing! They do an amazing job!
We truly appreciate your positive review!

We Had to make a very last minute decision to put down our family dog and decided to check out Dallas animal urgent care and the receptionist and doctor were fantastic and caring. They gave us time to mourn our dog before and after the euthanasia. They were super affordable and had no hidden cost.  They expressed how sorry they were that we had to meet under the circumstances and it truly showed. I’m so thankful that they made carrying out such a hard decision that much easier. Thank you

It’s an urgent care so in total I was there for about 2 hours, but so worth it. Also affordable! They even texted the next day checking in on my boy. So grateful for them and will be back if I ever need to. Thank you guys!
